saw_lines: Nobody buys a shoe on looks alone. Shoppers want to know when it arrives and whether it can come back.
So the sale is won or lost in the ad itself, when a shopper decides whether to trust the delivery.
Your site explains how orders ship, yet 0 of 30 ads mention shipping or delivery. Open ads for new buyers with a plain delivery answer in line one.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 29 Oct 2026
points: Your site explains how orders ship, yet 0 of 30 ads mention shipping or delivery, so new buyers get no answer to their first worry. Open ads for new buyers with a plain delivery answer in line one.

None of your 30 ads shows a proof number, so a buyer comparing you with other leather brands has nothing firm to hold onto. Collect a real figure, like orders shipped, and lead the next batch of ads with it.
5 of your 18 copy ads open on la rentrée se dessine chez, and the rest each use a single opener, so a season line carries the account. Test a boot story and a sandal story against it.
0 of 18 copy ads carry an offer or discount, so a shopper who is not sold yet has no reason to act today. Give new buyers a first order offer in the first line of your next ads.
